application_credentials.description:
To sign in with Google, create an OAuth client in [Google Cloud Console]({console_url}):
1. In your project, [enable the Gmail API]({gmail_api_url}). The integration cannot read mail without it.
1. Set up the [OAuth consent screen]({oauth_consent_url}) and publish the app (In production). Apps left in Testing lose the sign-in after 7 days.
1. Under [Credentials]({oauth_creds_url}) select **Create credentials** → **OAuth client ID** → **Web application**, with the authorized redirect URI `{redirect_url}`.
1. Enter the client ID and secret here.

The integration only asks for read-only Gmail access. More: [README]({more_info_url}).

user.title: CFE bills from email
user.description: How should Home Assistant read the email that brings the CFE bills (the CFDI XML attachments)?

imap.title: Mail server (IMAP)
imap.description: Connect the mailbox that receives the CFE bills (the CFDI XML attachments). For Gmail, use an app password.

data_description.password: A Gmail app password, not your account password.
data_description.folder: Mailbox folder that receives the bills, e.g. INBOX.
data_description.rpu: The 12-digit RPU printed on the bill.

rpu.title: Service number
rpu.description: Signed in with Google. Enter the service number of the bills to track.

data_description.rpu: The 12-digit RPU printed on the bill.

reauth_confirm.title: Mailbox login failed
reauth_confirm.description: The mailbox rejected the login for {username}. Enter a new app password.

reauth_google.title: Sign in with Google again
reauth_google.description: Google no longer accepts the sign-in for the CFE bills (it expired or was revoked). Sign in again to keep reading new bills. Stored bills stay visible meanwhile.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the IMAP server or open the folder.
error.invalid_auth: The mailbox rejected the email address or app password.
error.invalid_rpu: The RPU must be exactly 12 digits.

abort.already_configured: This service number (RPU) is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: Access restored. Home Assistant is checking the mailbox again.
abort.missing_configuration: Google sign-in is not set up. Add application credentials first (see the integration README).
abort.missing_credentials: Google sign-in needs application credentials (an OAuth client ID and secret). Add them first.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out creating the Google sign-in link.
abort.no_url_available: No Home Assistant URL is available for the sign-in redirect. See [the docs]({docs_url}).
abort.oauth_failed: Could not get a token from Google.
abort.oauth_timeout: Timed out getting a token from Google.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: Google rejected the client ID or secret.
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: The Google sign-in provider is unavailable. Try again later.
abort.missing_scope: Gmail access was not granted. Sign in again and allow Home Assistant to view your email messages.
abort.wrong_account: Wrong Google account. Sign in with {email}.
abort.api_disabled: The Gmail API is not enabled in your Google Cloud project. Enable it in Google Cloud Console, then try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach Gmail. Try again later.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Checks the mailbox for new CFE bills now.
